queryLines:

  *

  employeedatacatalog.gold_youtube.bc_category_scorecard

    array_contains(:sentiment, sentiment)
    OR cardinality(:sentiment) = 0
  )
  AND (
    array_contains(:category_name, category_name)

datasets.name: leaderboard_monopoly
queryLines:
SELECT
  trending_date,
  unique_channels,
  total_daily_views,
  top_channel_views,
  bottom_channel_views,
  view_concentration,
  top1_share_pct,
  monopoly_flag,
  is_high_monopoly
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      trending_date,
      unique_channels,
      total_daily_views,
      top_channel_views,
      bottom_channel_views,
      view_concentration,
      top1_share_pct,
      CASE
        WHEN top1_share_pct >= 40 THEN 'High Monopoly'
        WHEN top1_share_pct >= 25 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'Diverse'
      END AS monopoly_flag,
      CASE
        WHEN top1_share_pct >= 40 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END AS is_high_monopoly
    FROM
      (
        SELECT
          trending_date,
          COUNT(DISTINCT channel_key) AS unique_channels,
          SUM(daily_total_views) AS total_daily_views,
          MAX(daily_total_views) AS top_channel_views,
          MIN(daily_total_views) AS bottom_channel_views,
          CAST(
            ROUND(MAX(daily_total_views) / NULLIF(MIN(daily_total_views), 0), 1) AS DOUBLE
          ) AS view_concentration,
          CAST(
            ROUND(MAX(daily_total_views) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(daily_total_views), 0), 1) AS DOUBLE
          ) AS top1_share_pct
        FROM
          employeedatacatalog.gold_youtube.channel_daily_leaderboard
        GROUP BY
          trending_date
      )
  )
ORDER BY
  trending_date

datasets.name: high_monopoly_count
queryLines:
SELECT
  trending_date,
  CAST(
    ROUND(MAX(daily_total_views) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(daily_total_views), 0), 1) AS DOUBLE
  ) AS top1_share_pct
FROM
  employeedatacatalog.gold_youtube.channel_daily_leaderboard
GROUP BY
  trending_date
HAVING
  CAST(ROUND(MAX(daily_total_views) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(daily_total_views), 0), 1) AS DOUBLE) >= 40
